name: Girga

queries.query: Girga Egypt cadastral parcels GIS land registry official
queries.result: Search identified Egypt’s first-party Survey Authority as the national producer of topographic/digital maps and land-survey services, plus no public Girga parcel feature service or anonymous parcel API.

queries.query: جيرجا مصر خريطة كادسترية قطع الأراضي السجل العقاري موقع رسمي
queries.result: Search found official Egyptian Survey Authority map/survey information and an official Girga tax-office page covering Girga administrative boundaries, but no public cadastral map/API, safe parcel identity response, geometry, schema, or CRS for Girga.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Egyptian General Survey Authority (national surveying and mapping authority)
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The official site describes national mapping, land-survey, digital-map, coordinate-certificate, and parcel-allocation services. It does not expose an anonymous public Girga parcel viewer or feature endpoint in the inspected page links.

The official map guide says detailed maps can depict private-land boundaries and numbers and that paper/digital map products support land registration; it is a product/service description, not a downloadable Girga parcel layer.
Official Girga-specific administrative coverage page for the tax office in Sohag Governorate. It is not evidence of a cadastral registry or parcel geometry service.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: General Organization for Physical Planning (GOPP), Egypt
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official page describes national spatial-planning basemap and urban-boundary data integration, not cadastral parcel identities or a public parcel geometry endpoint.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: HTTP page available to search inspection; direct curl blocked by expired certificate
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Inspected official navigation and linked service pages. No public parcel viewer/API URL was exposed. TLS verification was not disabled and no certificate exception was used.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: official document found; direct large-PDF retrieval not retained
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Read search-indexed official description of map products and land-boundary/number content. No machine-readable parcel response, native IDs, or CRS endpoint.
Official service listing indicates a request for a survey statement for a land parcel and requires selecting governorate/area. It did not provide public parcel geometry or an anonymous data endpoint.
Girga tax-office coverage page read; no cadastral map, parcel schema, or parcel geometry route.
Spatial-planning basemap/urban-boundary integration page read; no public cadastral parcel service or safe native parcel IDs.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Egyptian Survey Authority describes national map and survey products; GOPP describes national spatial-planning basemap integration; Girga tax office coverage is administrative only.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: not ready; no public native parcel identity plus geometry response
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: none beyond public service/schema discovery; no owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, or account fields requested
safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly exposed

blocker: No anonymous first-party Girga parcel viewer/API, schema response, CRS response, or geometry-only extract was verified after bounded English and Arabic discovery. Direct ESA curl access also encountered an expired certificate; TLS verification was preserved.
remainingUncertainty: Survey Authority digital products or local cadastral records may be available through an offline/request workflow. Search failure, the PSM 502, TLS certificate failure, and lack of an exact-point hit do not establish citywide absence.
nextStep: On a later attempt, locate a current first-party Egyptian Survey Authority or Sohag/Girga cadastral viewer/API and inspect its JavaScript/configuration for a safe geometry-plus-native-ID response before considering adapter qualification.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON retained because no safe, verified native parcel identity and geometry response was available.
